title: Notice of damage later than 72 hours after discovery
cite: 7 CFR 457.8, section 14(b)(1) — FCIC Common Crop Insurance Policy Basic Provisions 27.1-BR (RMA, released June 2026, 2027 crop year): wording unchanged from 26-BR
why: For a planted crop you must give notice, by unit, within 72 hours of your initial discovery of damage or loss of production.
fix: Give notice to the agent within 72 hours of discovery and record the date in notice_given.

title: Notice later than 15 days after the insurance period ended
cite: 7 CFR 457.8, section 14(b)(1) — FCIC Common Crop Insurance Policy Basic Provisions 27.1-BR (RMA, released June 2026, 2027 crop year): wording unchanged from 26-BR
why: Notice is due no later than 15 days after the end of the insurance period, even if the crop is not harvested.

title: Damage recorded but no notice given, 72 hours passed
cite: 7 CFR 457.8, section 14(b)(1) and (b)(5) — FCIC Common Crop Insurance Policy Basic Provisions 27.1-BR (RMA, released June 2026, 2027 crop year): wording unchanged from 26-BR
why: If you fail to submit a notice of loss, the loss is considered solely due to an uninsured cause: no indemnity is paid and premiums are still owed.
fix: Call the agent now, then record notice_given and confirm in writing.

title: Phone or in-person notice not confirmed in writing within 15 days
cite: 7 CFR 457.8, section 14(b)(4) — FCIC Common Crop Insurance Policy Basic Provisions 27.1-BR (RMA, released June 2026, 2027 crop year): wording unchanged from 26-BR
why: A notice made by telephone or in person to the crop insurance agent must be confirmed in writing within 15 days.
fix: Send the written confirmation and record written_confirmation.

title: Prevented planting notice later than 72 hours after the final planting date
cite: 7 CFR 457.8, section 14(b)(3) — FCIC Common Crop Insurance Policy Basic Provisions 27.1-BR (RMA, released June 2026, 2027 crop year): wording unchanged from 26-BR
why: If you do not intend to plant during the late planting period (or none applies), notice is due within 72 hours after the final planting date.
fix: Record pp_notice within 72 hours of final_planting_date, or set late_planting: yes with the date you decided.

title: Claim for indemnity later than 60 days after the insurance period ended
cite: 7 CFR 457.8, section 14(e)(3) — FCIC Common Crop Insurance Policy Basic Provisions 27.1-BR (RMA, released June 2026, 2027 crop year): wording unchanged from 26-BR
why: For policies other than revenue protection, the claim is due 60 days after the insurance period ends for all acreage in the unit. For revenue protection it is the later of that date and 60 days after the harvest price is released. If the unit has acreage whose insurance period ended on different dates, the 60 days run from the last of them.
fix: Submit the claim, or request an extension in writing before the due date; it is granted only if the loss amount cannot yet be determined (section 14(e)(1)(i)).

title: Damage reported under 15 days before harvest: leave representative samples
cite: 7 CFR 457.8, section 14(c)(1) — FCIC Common Crop Insurance Policy Basic Provisions 27.1-BR (RMA, released June 2026, 2027 crop year): wording unchanged from 26-BR
why: If you report damage less than 15 days before harvest begins, or during harvest, you must leave representative samples of the unharvested crop intact when the Crop Provisions require them.
fix: Leave 10-foot-wide sample strips and record samples: left.

title: Revenue protection unit without a harvest price release date
cite: 7 CFR 457.8, section 14(e)(3)(ii) — FCIC Common Crop Insurance Policy Basic Provisions 27.1-BR (RMA, released June 2026, 2027 crop year): wording unchanged from 26-BR
why: For revenue protection the claim date is the later of 60 days after the harvest price release and 60 days after the insurance period ends; without the release date the due date cannot be known. Section 14(b)(2): a revenue protection unit with a revenue loss but no damage still needs notice within 45 days after the latest harvest price release.

title: Date not in YYYY-MM-DD form
why: 07/08/2026 reads as July 8 in the US and 7 August elsewhere; a deadline computed from the wrong one is off by a month.
